scope: Read-only comparison of existing raw outputs; no new numerical solves. HDF5 containers compared through complete h5dump with 17-digit floating values; only first-line filename normalized.

summary.timing_claim: Single-run timing data recorded only; no repeated timing comparison or speedup claim.

limitations: Three bounded physical mesh levels (703/2299/5367 DoFs) on one host and 1/2 ranks do not establish asymptotic mesh independence.
The corrected PCD still takes more outer iterations than the historical unchanged nodal or BFBt modes in these cases.
Default n3 patch mode increases corrected PCD iterations relative to corrected PCD without patches, so patch benefits are not universal.
Pressure-transport inlet Robin boundary correction and variable-viscosity PCD remain outside the implemented producer contract.
Old default/RCR binaries are c5af27d; old study binary is e565c98. New direct references were re-solved and cross-compared, and common inputs/mesh/decoded partition/solver options were verified.
All full HDF5 container hashes differ across regenerated partitions; their complete decoded datatypes, datasets and attributes agree. Raw hashes are retained.
